title: M2.12: Guests: admitted outsiders and the guest grant
description:
Implement guest admission records, the guest channel participant (author kind external), the guest grant (reply-only on the same thread, no computer, no consequential class, smaller budget), per-binding guest toggle default off, and the one-polite-notice behavior when over budget. Recommended to ship last in M2 because it is the riskiest part.

Acceptance criteria:
- An admitted guest gets answers on its own thread only; the guest cannot see other channels
- Guest cannot cause a computer start or an approval-class action
- Disabling guests mid-thread stops further turns and keeps history
- Guest personal data is purged with the admission

Gherkin: features/external_guest_access.feature

Depends on: M2.3, M2.5, M2.6

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
